title: Multi-file invoice repair
prompt: Repair invoice totals so they follow CONTRACT.md, including invalid inputs and exact cents. Keep existing public exports. Change only src/money.mjs and src/invoice.mjs. Finish with a concise explanation of the cause and the checks you actually performed.

files.CONTRACT.md:
# Invoice contract

toCents accepts primitive strings matching digits with an optional decimal point and one or two decimal digits. No signs, whitespace, exponent notation or other types. Values must be from 0 through 9999.99 inclusive; invalid input throws TypeError. Return exact integer cents.

invoiceTotal accepts an array of objects with price and quantity. Quantity must be an integer from 1 through 1000. Reject invalid arrays, records or quantities with TypeError. Sum price cents multiplied by quantity, returning 0 for an empty array. Do not mutate input.

Run the visible checks with npm test. Keep tests, this contract and package metadata unchanged.
